findings.message: The ownership contract gives phase3-exit `owns: [tickets]` and nothing else. Section 20 says phase3-exit transitively covers Phase 3 and seeds Phase 4. The merged exit precedent (tickets/phase2-exit) re-reads the exit criteria from committed artifacts through its own merged test (tests/test_phase2_exit.py) and pins the next phase's seeds through a seeded test (tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py). With only the ticket plane fenced, the phase3-exit Implement has nowhere to put its exit-read test or its Phase 4 seed-pinning test. It is also barred from changing paths under tickets/ in its own diff, as the phase2-exit precedent shows. The seed as pinned is therefore not buildable.
findings.paved_road: Change the phase3-exit ownership to `owns: [tickets, tests/test_phase3_exit.py, tests/test_seeded_phase4_core.py]` (or equivalent new exit and seeded-test paths), `hooks: []`. Pin that fence and those new-path owners in tests/test_seeded_phase3_20.py.

findings.message: Exit-read closure is missing. The terminal exit's natural read is the committed report tickets/soak-run/daemon-soak-report.json, but neither the scope nor the criteria name the report's machinery (daemon-soak: eval/daemon_soak.py and its registered closed report schema in squatch/artifacts.py) or its producer (soak-run). The phase3-exit criteria the seed must carry are also left unspecified.
findings.paved_road: State in Scope in that phase3-exit reads tickets/soak-run/daemon-soak-report.json, validated against the daemon-soak report schema, with daemon-soak as the machinery and soak-run as the producer. Add an acceptance criterion requiring tests/test_seeded_phase3_20.py to pin that phase3-exit names both, and that phase3-exit's depends reach soak-run.

findings.message: Scope in says to pin 'dependencies, tiers, budgets, fences, Context partition' but never states their values. The only acceptance criterion ('pins the terminal admissions and rejects a successor') cannot check the dependency edges (soak-run on this continuation and/or daemon-soak; phase3-exit on soak-run), the medium/medium tiers (neither seed is KNOWN-DEEP), or each seed's exact Context. That leaves the review unable to check the ticket against the plan.
findings.paved_road: List the exact depends, tier (medium/medium), budget (75m/150m) and Context for soak-run and phase3-exit in Scope in. Add criteria that tests/test_seeded_phase3_20.py pins each of them. The pattern is tests/test_seeded_phase3_11.py BATCH/CONTEXT/EXISTING_AT_AUTHORING.
